I took a policy from Reliance General Insurance, and it has turned out to be one of the worst experiences of my life. For the past 9 months, this company has caused me immense mental, financial, and emotional stress — to the point where I feel like I am shedding tears of blood.

Despite countless follow-ups, there has been no proper response, no accountability, and no resolution. The customer support is completely irresponsible and unhelpful. I was repeatedly given false assurances, but nothing was actually resolved.

Because of this insurance, I have suffered continuous stress, wasted time, and harassment. The fact that my issue remains unresolved even after 9 months clearly shows the inefficiency and failure of Reliance General Insurance.

I would strongly warn others not to take any policy from this company. This feedback is written with extreme frustration and disappointment.
